desc: Represent the column transformation matrix M_j (lower-triangular) and build the segment tree with product matrices.
Use the insight that the matrix is determined by its first column (prefix products) to store only vectors of length H per node.
Implement matrix multiplication of two such matrices in O(H) time using the formula v_combined[i] = v_right[i] * (prefix sum of v_left[k] * inv(v_right[k-1])).
Build the segment tree iteratively, storing vectors in a flat list `tree` of length 2*size*H.
Process Q updates by updating the leaf, recomputing the vector for that column, and pulling up to the root.
Output the answer after each update as the last element of the root's vector.
Test on the provided sample inputs to verify correctness and performance.
